summary_zh: 15 道题的答案都核对过，没有问题。只改了解答开头的一句约定说明：原文把 Adam 的矩也说成“未归一化”，其实只有动量的速度项是；Adam 的写法本来就带 (1−β) 权重。

issues.where: 参考解答开头的约定说明
issues.problem_zh: 开头说“下面动量和 Adam 的更新规则用的是未归一化的速度/矩项”。这句话对动量成立（v_t = μ·v_{t−1} + g_t 没有 (1−μ) 权重），但 Q6 里 Adam 的 m_t、v_t 带 (1−β₁)、(1−β₂) 权重，本身就是归一化的写法，说成“未归一化”容易让人看糊涂。
issues.change_zh: 已改：把这句里的“和 Adam”“/矩”删掉，现在只说动量用的是未归一化的速度项；Adam 的写法本来就带 (1−β) 权重。中英文两版都改了。

Q10 ridge by numerical minimisation vs closed form, SVD form and shrink factors; coordinatewise ridge c/(1+lambda) and lasso soft threshold by 1-D minimisation (and that the threshold is lambda/2 without the leading 1/2)

Q14 optimal discriminator by pointwise numerical maximisation; V(D*) = -log 4 + 2 JSD; both generator-loss gradients against autograd
Q15 importance-weighting identity by quadrature (target accuracy 0.939 = weighted source; unweighted source 0.776); definitions of covariate/label/concept shift read against the standard ones

env_evidence: Two conventions worth pinning down before answering out loud: the momentum and Adam update rules below use an unnormalised velocity/moment term, the common convention in ML courses and frameworks — a textbook that instead weights the momentum term by $(1-\mu)$ describes the same algorithm up to a rescaling of the effective learning rate.
